Summary Issue #484: several commands wrote a failure to stderr and then exited 0. Their handlers set `Environment.ExitCode` inside a `void` `SetHandler`, and `Main` returns `InvokeAsync`, which only keeps `ctx.ExitCode`. Refusal paths now return that code and assign `ctx.ExitCode`. Success paths still return 0. ## Changes - `mesh --set-trust-tier` exits 1 for a missing peer and for a malformed tier, matching `mesh admit` / `mesh revoke`. - `rollback` exits 1 when the adaptation id has no snapshot, and when neither an adaptation id nor `--to-snapshot` is given. The adaptation id argument is optional (`Arity` zero-or-one) so a bare `rollback` reaches that usage check instead of dying in the parser. - The same return path is used in `adapt`, `analyze-bricks`, `compose`, `improve`, `ingest-failures`, `observe`, and `docker` (`build`, `run`, `clean`, `ps`, `images`). `docker run` returns the container exit code, or 1 when the run failed and the container code was 0. - Tests cover the listed refusals. `TestParallelCommand`, `ChatCommand`, and the commercial mesh director still set `Environment.ExitCode` and were left alone. ## Testing `scripts/test-in-container.sh --repo /tmp/ashlar-cli-exit-clone --project application/src/Ashlar.Tests.CLI/Ashlar.Tests.CLI.csproj --filter 'FullyQualifiedName~CliHandlerExitCodeTests|DisplayName~MeshCommandTests'` Passed: 16, failed: 0, skipped: 0. The devtest container has no Docker daemon, so `docker run` was proven for the unavailable-daemon and missing-image refusals only, not for a live container exit code. ### Testing strategy (blast radius) See [Testing strategy pivot v1](docs/architecture/TestingStrategyPivot-v1.md). | Change type | Minimum proof (check what applies) | |-------------|-------------------------------------| | `Ashlar.Core.Domain` | `dotnet test src/Ashlar.Tests.Domain` · `make kernel-coverage-gate` | | Infrastructure adapter (small / branchy) | Focused unit or gap test in touched file · coverage gate | | Hosting / API / routing / barriers / `AddAshlar` | `make test-prod-style` and/or `make application-gate-tier-c` | | Docker / mesh / fleet / trust | `make mesh-lab-e2e` or relevant `*-gate` tier (see pivot doc) | | Megaclass (`ProviderFactory`, Docker provisioners, …) | **ProdStyle / virtual host** — do not add new `*GapCoverageTests` files | - [x] Focused CLI tests for the refusal paths (command handlers and their tests; no kernel or hosting change) - [ ] `make kernel-coverage-gate` (if touching `src/Ashlar.Core.*` or `src/Ashlar.Infrastructure`) - [ ] `make kernel-gate` (if touching kernel hosting / pipeline / profiles) - [ ] `make test-prod-style` (if touching production DI / API / routing) ## Checklist - [x] Focused `Ashlar.Tests.CLI` filter passes in the devtest container - [x] Knowledge graph regenerated for the new test file - [x] No `TODO` or `NotImplementedException` left unresolved - [x] Breaking changes are documented — refusal paths that previously exited 0 now exit non-zero, which is the fix ## Release (only when this PR ships a **versioned** NuGet/GHCR release) - [x] Not a versioned release — skip
